name: Hino Kokona
source:
[url=https://vndb.org/c169626]Shouta’s[/url] and [url=https://vndb.org/c110155]Eimi’s[/url] mother.  
A gentle, sweet, and doting mother on the surface, but this is merely a facade she maintains to play the role of the ideal mother so that her beloved Shouta won’t dislike her.  

In her student days, she was an even wilder gyaru than Eimi, and when she reveals her true self, she still transforms back into a gyaru.  

She ends up going on a trip with her longtime friend [url=https://vndb.org/c169461]Bluette[/url] and her junior [url=https://vndb.org/c169462]Yua[/url]. After deciding to swim in the sea, she resolves to go on a diet.  

Since Kokona gets bored easily, she believes she’ll be able to stick with the diet if she does it while flirting and getting intimate with her beloved son Shouta. Thus, she boldly offers her body in a dangerous, lewd way to ask for his help.

[Translated from [url=https://www.getchu.com/item/1368656/]Getchu[/url]]
